text:
[Council File 26-1456; CD 14]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (JURADO – BLUMENFIELD) and RESOLUTION relative to allowing the California Municipal Finance Authority to issue revenue bonds for an affordable multifamily housing development located at 1624 South Hope Street in Council District 14 (Project).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
CONSIDER the results of the Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA) public hearing held on April 9, 2026 for the Project.
ADOPT the accompanying TEFRA RESOLUTION to allow the California Municipal Finance Authority to issue revenue bonds or notes in an amount not to exceed $21,000,000 to finance and/or refinance the acquisition, rehabilitation, improvement, renovation, furnishing and equipping of a 97-unit affordable multifamily housing development located at 1624 South Hope Street in Council District 14.

outcome.text: Council adopted item forthwith (Oct 16, 2026); Council action final
